## Purpose

Presentation only. The trading terminal, account area and back office read the API and render it.

## Inputs

## Outputs

- web app
- mobile app

## What gets built

- trading terminal (quotes, ticket, blotter, positions)
- account area (funding, statements, profile, verification)
- sign-in, registration, sessions and two-factor authentication
- operator console (apps/ops) — separate app, separate port, separate deploy
- back office / admin console
- design system and accessibility baseline

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-190: the UI never owns financial truth and never computes a balance or P&L locally except as a labelled optimistic preview.
- INV-191: the rendered page contains no financial figure that did not come from the API, and performs no arithmetic on money.
- INV-192: the session token is never reachable by script; it lives in an HttpOnly, SameSite cookie and appears in no response body, URL or browser store.

## Test obligations

- component and E2E suites against a stubbed API
- accessibility checks
- visual regression
- the auth screens render, refuse and explain themselves, signed in and signed out
- the sign-in and registration forms complete with JavaScript disabled
- the operator console renders every screen, escapes client-supplied text, and refuses a forged session

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.

_none declared_
